author: Noah (design) / Claude (build)
goal: Make the existing desktop build fully playable on a touch surface (phone) as a responsive add-on, without changing desktop feel or forking the codebase. Keyboard/mouse remain fully functional; touch controls appear only on touch-capable devices.
design_authority_notes: All numeric/visual values below are PLACEHOLDERS, tuned live after build (feel-first).
Google Doc referenced by Noah could not be fetched (no Drive connector this session); PRD is built from repo + Noah's explicit rulings only. If the doc adds touch constraints, PRD must be revised.
No blind file overwrites: repo was cloned and read first. ShipTiers.js confirmed at js/systems/ (path conflict from prior memory is already resolved in remote). No ' copy.js' junk present.

confirmed_design_rulings.steering: Hold-to-turn BUTTONS (not a joystick). Left-turn and right-turn buttons mirror A / D (.isDown, continuous while held).
confirmed_design_rulings.sail_throttle: Two buttons: sail+ (mirrors W, JustDown) and sail- (mirrors S, JustDown). 3 sail states preserved.
confirmed_design_rulings.layout: Left side = movement cluster (turn L, turn R, sail+, sail-). Right side = firing cluster (bow, stern, port, starboard).
confirmed_design_rulings.firing: Four discrete fire buttons mirroring cursor Up=bow, Down=stern, and Q=port / E=starboard. Each = one JustDown-equivalent pulse per tap.
confirmed_design_rulings.capture_and_dock_by_tap: Tapping a port or ship in the world triggers dock-or-capture. Rule (Noah): if scene.inCombat() -> try CAPTURE; if NOT in combat -> try DOCK.
confirmed_design_rulings.ship_capture_tap: Boarding auto-targets already. A tap anywhere near the auto-targeted ship is sufficient to trigger the capture attempt; no per-enemy pixel hit-test required.
confirmed_design_rulings.map_open: Tapping the minimap opens the world map (mirrors M).
confirmed_design_rulings.docked_shop: Stays a numbered list 1-9,0, but each row becomes tappable. Tapping a row invokes the same action its number key does.

architecture.pattern: Namespaced-global-singleton (methods take scene first), consistent with existing systems.
architecture.new_module: js/systems/TouchInput.js — global TouchInput singleton. Owns on-screen control state and DOM/Phaser button objects.
architecture.seam: GameScene.update() is the single input funnel. It reads keyboard via .isDown (hold) and Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown (edge). TouchInput exposes matching accessors: TouchInput.held(name) and TouchInput.justDown(name). Existing reads get OR-ed with touch equivalents. Minimal, additive edits only — no logic rewrite.
architecture.capture_dock_reuse: Tap handler calls the SAME entry points as keys: PortCaptureSystem.tryCapture(scene) / BoardingSystem.tryBoard(scene) for capture, and the existing dock branch for docking. Both capture fns already self-check range+threshold and return truthy on consume.
architecture.no_new_physics: Steering still runs through calcTurnDegS + heading integration in GameScene. Touch only feeds the same boolean gates.

device_detection.rule: Show touch overlay only when a touch device is detected: (('ontouchstart' in window) || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0). Also expose a manual override flag (window.FORCE_TOUCH) for desktop testing.
device_detection.desktop_unaffected: When touch overlay is off, no buttons render and no touch state is read; keyboard path is byte-for-byte unchanged.

responsive_scaling.current_state: GAME_W/H already = window.innerWidth/innerHeight; viewport meta present. Canvas fills screen.
responsive_scaling.open_question_SCALE: No Phaser Scale Manager configured. On orientation change / resize the canvas does not currently re-fit. NEEDS RULING: add Phaser.Scale.RESIZE + a resize handler to reposition touch buttons, or leave scale out of scope for this pass? (Recommend: add RESIZE; buttons reposition on resize event.)
responsive_scaling.button_units: Button positions/sizes expressed as fractions of screen W/H so they scale across phone sizes. All exact fractions are placeholders.

button_layout_placeholder.note: Positions are placeholders for live tuning. Left cluster bottom-left, right cluster bottom-right, thumb-reachable.
button_layout_placeholder.rendering: Rendered in UIScene (runs parallel, on top of GameScene, scrollFactor 0) to match existing HUD button pattern (HUD.js flag buttons use setScrollFactor(0).setInteractive). Buttons set depth above HUD.
